title: ForgeFlow Project Config
description: Project settings for ForgeFlow CLI and IDE adapters. All fields are optional; missing keys use defaults.

adapter.description: LLM adapter host. Controls which prompt templates are loaded from .forgeflow/adapter/<name>/.

mode.description: Execution mode. 'auto' loops until TERMINAL or blocked; 'manual' runs one step at a time.

auto_parallel.description: When true, enables parallel execution of independent workflow stages (future feature).

blocker_timeout_minutes.description: How long (in minutes) a BLOCKED state persists before auto-resolving or requiring user intervention.

root_artifact_dir.description: Path to the artifact root where all workflow outputs are stored. Must be a directory path.

workflows.description: Workflow definitions. Each key is a workflow name with settings for prompt file, artifact naming, and transitions.

transitions.description: Global fallback transition rules evaluated when handoff parsing fails.

name.description: Workflow identifier matching the key in workflows object.

prompt_file.description: Relative path to the prompt file (resolved under .forgeflow/adapter/<adapter>/).

artifact.description: Canonical filename template for artifacts produced by this workflow.

scope.description: Execution scope: Project, Feature, or Slice.

auto_next.description: Name of the workflow to forward to when this one completes successfully.

loops.description: When true, allows returning to this workflow after blockers are resolved.

on_blocker_return.description: Map of Blocker Categories to Return Workflow names (e.g., BUSINESS_GAP -> plan).

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the transition rule.

condition.description: Natural language description of when this rule applies.

forward.description: Target workflow name to forward to (null means no forward).

return_to.description: Target workflow to return to on failure (null means no return).

loops_back.description: Whether this transition creates a loop back to an earlier stage.
